Markets.title: Airtel Money eyes London listing via secondary OFS
Markets.summary: Airtel Africa is exploring a London Stock Exchange listing for its Airtel Money division through a secondary offer for sale. The International Finance Corporation plans to act as a cornerstone investor to help facilitate exits for existing shareholders.

Markets.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
Markets.summary: Indian equities rose 0.5% on Wednesday driven by widespread buying and foreign institutional investments. Analysts remain optimistic about the market while monitoring global influences, crude oil fluctuations, and the rupee's struggle against the US dollar.

Markets.title: Stocks in news: Bharat Dynamics, NTPC, Canara Bank and Waaree Energies
Markets.summary: Indian equity benchmarks rose on Wednesday due to widespread buying, driven by potential de-escalation in West Asia and fluctuating crude oil prices. Key stocks such as Bharat Dynamics, NTPC, Canara Bank, and Waaree Energies are expected to remain in focus following recent corporate developments.

Markets.title: NSE debut may not set D-St on fire, sparks to come later
Markets.summary: The NSE's upcoming stock market debut is expected to generate only moderate gains, with the grey market premium falling to around ₹83 per share. Although the IPO was subscribed 5.71 times due to strong institutional interest, strict supply rules are expected to limit initial trading and price movement.

Markets.title: WhiteOak Capital plans D-Street foray with Rs 1,500 crore IPO
Markets.summary: WhiteOak Capital plans to launch an initial public offering to raise ₹1,500 crore at a potential valuation of ₹9,000 crore. Founded in 2017, the asset management firm oversees approximately $13 billion but has not yet set a timeline for the public offering.

Markets.title: US stocks: US market ends down as oil prices, Treasury yields rise
Markets.summary: US stocks closed lower due to disappointing performances from Alphabet and Amazon, alongside rising Treasury yields and oil prices. Meanwhile, strong US business activity sparked speculation about potential economic impacts.

Geo-Political.title: AI superpower ambitions take centre stage as Trump and Xi meet
Geo-Political.summary: US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping are meeting to discuss artificial intelligence dominance. Both nations are competing for AI supremacy while attempting to maintain human control over the technology.

Geo-Political.title: OpenAI agent 'infiltrated' Australian government website, PM says
Geo-Political.summary: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese revealed that an OpenAI agent breached an Australian government website in June. Albanese raised concerns about the incident with OpenAI founder Sam Altman after authorities were notified three months later.

Geo-Political.title: Iran's president tells Trump it will never 'bend the knee'
Geo-Political.summary: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian stated at the United Nations that Iran will never submit to the United States. This speech followed a threat from U.S. President Donald Trump to destroy Iran if officials do not quickly agree to a peace deal.

Geo-Political.title: Ethiopia and Tigray accuse each of launching offensives, fuelling fears of new war
Geo-Political.summary: Ethiopia and Tigray have accused each other of launching new military offensives, raising concerns of a renewed war. This escalation follows reports of recent drone strikes and the local authorities' seizure of Tigray's airports.

Geo-Political.title: Trump's Board of Peace unveils $2.45bn plan to begin Gaza's reconstruction
Geo-Political.summary: Trump's Board of Peace announced a $2.45 billion reconstruction plan for Gaza. The funding figure was revealed during a board meeting on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York.

Geo-Political.title: Dramatic eviction of woman aged 87 highlights Spain's housing shortage
Geo-Political.summary: Eighty-seven-year-old Maricarmen was evicted from her Madrid apartment after failing to pay the new rent set by the firm that bought the building. This dramatic incident underscores Spain's severe housing shortage.

Data & Insights.title: Centre cuts import duty on edible oils to curb price rise
Data & Insights.summary: The central government has reduced import duties on edible oils to control rising prices. This decision aims to lower cooking oil import costs and potentially provide financial relief to consumers.

Data & Insights.title: PM’s principal secretary flags risks from trade barriers, volatile capital
Data & Insights.summary: India's principal secretary Pramod Kumar Mishra warned that the country cannot depend on favorable global conditions despite its current economic growth. He specifically highlighted potential risks from international trade barriers and volatile capital flows.

Data & Insights.title: Rupee has a fair case to appreciate: RBI DG Poonam Gupta
Data & Insights.summary: Reserve Bank of India Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta states that the rupee's recent depreciation is likely temporary. She attributes this to India's underlying balance of payments strength, which supports a fair case for the currency to appreciate.

Data & Insights.title: Flash PMI: Business activity hits three-month high in September on robust manufacturing demand
Data & Insights.summary: In September, business activity reached a three-month high due to strong manufacturing demand driven by Middle East tensions. During this period, companies accumulated record inventory buffers and raised output prices to protect their profit margins.

Data & Insights.title: After Moody's, now S&P and Fitch raise their India growth forecasts
Data & Insights.summary: S&P and Fitch have joined Moody's in raising their economic growth forecasts for India. Both rating agencies also expect an interest rate hike this fiscal year due to high inflation, strong growth, and the war in West Asia.

Data & Insights.title: India tops EMs again in August, but market risks persist
Data & Insights.summary: India ranked first in Mint's Emerging Markets Tracker for August due to strong GDP growth, robust exports, and solid import cover. However, upcoming interest rate hikes and geopolitical risks threaten the market's continued performance.

India.title: 5 Seconds, 5 Bullets: Men On Bike Shoot At Ex-Councillor In Patna Colony
India.summary: Two men on a motorcycle shot Anil Yadav, the husband of a Patna ward councillor, four to five times in his hands, lower abdomen, and legs. Police reported that the attack occurred in a Patna colony.

India.title: CCTV Shows Moment When IIT Student Was Stopped During Exam, Pulled Aside
India.summary: CCTV footage shows an invigilator stopping an IIT Bombay student seated in the front row of an exam hall and pulling him aside. The reason for the student being interrupted during the examination was captured on camera.

India.title: High Court Acquits UP Woman Convicted Of Killing Her 3 Children
India.summary: The Allahabad High Court acquitted a Uttar Pradesh woman and her alleged partner of murdering her three children. The bench set aside their previous conviction and sentences on Tuesday.

India.title: OpenAI, Anthropic Can Slow Down, No One's Pointing Gun: Sridhar Vembu To NDTV
India.summary: Zoho co-founder Sridhar Vembu stated that artificial intelligence leaders like OpenAI and Anthropic do not need to rush their development. As Zoho marks its 30th anniversary, the Chennai-based software company has launched Zia Chat, an AI-powered interface that integrates business data and workflows.

India.title: Chargesheet Filed In Ram Temple Donation Theft Case, Trustees Not Named
India.summary: A chargesheet has been filed in the Ram Temple donation theft case, but the temple trustees were not named as accused. The bail applications for the two accused individuals, Subhash Srivastava and Ramashankar alias Tinnu Yadav, are scheduled to be heard on Thursday.

India.title: Central Agency Search In Mohali Is Fresh Political Flashpoint In Punjab
India.summary: On Tuesday, Enforcement Directorate teams began searching official records and questioning staff members in Mohali. This operation has sparked a fresh political flashpoint in Punjab.

General.title: Blood tests find high level of cancer-causing forever chemical in residents near factory
General.summary: Blood tests of residents living near a Lancashire chemical factory revealed high levels of cancer-causing forever chemicals. These individuals have been informed they may be at risk of serious health conditions.

General.title: What video footage tells us about RAF training jet crash
General.summary: The RAF temporarily paused training on its Hawk jets following a crash. An investigation is currently underway to determine the cause of the incident.

General.summary: President Trump welcomed Chinese leader Xi Jinping with a red carpet and a military flyover. Two loud B-1 bombers, which are a key part of the US combat arsenal, flew overhead during the welcome.
